estimands.primary: delta_p: incumbents' CAPPED price index min(Delta_p, 1) with the pre-lever (trunk) benchmarks (D-16; raw index reported as delta_p_raw)
estimands.own_scoring: delta_p_own: capped Delta_p of the sham on the trunk benchmarks minus capped Delta_p of the lever on its own market's pinned benchmarks (= the delta_p_window contrast), the D-17 co-condition for 'collusion reduction'
estimands.secondary: delta_pi_window: incumbents' profit-based Delta, per-window benchmarks

inference.sidedness: one-sided (alternative='greater'): H1 is Delta(sham) - Delta(arm) > 0, a reduction of collusion; BCa intervals are two-sided 95 %; TOST is two one-sided tests by construction
inference.h1_rule: D-3'/D-16/D-17/D-19: one pre-specified lever, capped index, one-sided paired t-tests on all qualified trunks under the trunk and the own scoring, no multiplicity; 'collusion reduction' iff p < alpha under both and the MQC point estimate <= 5 pp (trunk-only: 'price reduction consistent with competitive adjustment'); practically significant iff the one-sided 95 % paired-t lower bound > 0.1 (inconclusive when the 90 % interval straddles 0.10-0.20; BCa 90 % alongside)
inference.split_sample: descriptive only: best eligible lever (MQC point <= 5 pp, upper bound <= 7 pp) selected on odd-seed trunks, estimated on even-seed trunks; off with fewer than 3 trunks per half (D-22)

gate2.fallback: F1 (s0.5, relaunch 12 trunks) then F2 (2 dealers)

qualification.note: no trunk runs of any lane in this campaign: every paired trunk is used

sigma_d.source: pooled SD of realised lever-minus-sham differences across trunks

rule.scorings: trunk (primary) and own benchmarks; collusion reduction needs both (D-17)

best_lever_split_sample.label: descriptive (no decision; selection on odd-seed, estimation on even-seed trunks)
best_lever_split_sample.status: off: 0 selection and 0 estimation trunks, fewer than 3 per half (D-22)
